selection: candidate IDs are first up to3 from fixed BM25 capture; try in ranking order; keep each whole source if complete chat fits; skip rejected source and try remaining candidates; never backfill below top3
smallBudgets: 256 and384 are didactic packing variants,not changes to the frozen A/B input limit
comparisonInvariant: At1536 every retrieved top3 source must fit for both tokenizers and source texts/messages must match; otherwise preserve failure,do not silently alter A/B inputs
serialization: two messages: fixed system and user containing question plus JSON array of id,title,body; no gold labels,required fact IDs or review notes

metrics.selectedDocumentRelevance: selected docs with grade>=1 / selected docs; null when empty
metrics.requiredFactCoverage: distinct required fact IDs whose exact canonical source is selected / required facts; null when no required facts
metrics.requiredEvidenceShareOfSourceText: union of annotated required quote ranges in selected bodies / total selected body UTF-16 units; null when denominator0; excludes titles,system,question,JSON/template
metrics.limitations: structural proxies from authored gold,not Ragas scores or a semantic judge; cannot prove model use,answer faithfulness or corpus-wide completeness

overBudgetBase: record diagnostic token count, no operational prompt or evidence metrics
emptyContext: base fits but zero sources; admitted input,doc ratio and evidence text fraction null; required coverage0 for answerable queries
execution: two real tokenizers,20 queries,3limits,120compositions; no weights loaded,no generated tokens
